verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair question to ask. The pack shows nothing of the kind: there is no API explorer, playground, or 'try it' feature. A probe found a raw /openapi.json file, which is only a spec a developer could build an explorer from. The Markdown docs and /llms-full.txt are static documentation for agents, not interactive or runnable references.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
